recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
rulers: President Paul KAGAME (since 22 April 2000); Prime Minister Justin NSENGIYUMVA (since 23 July 2025)
economy: low-income Sub-Saharan economy; services, industry, and agriculture sectors driving growth; increased government spending on human capital, energy, and healthcare; major infrastructure projects including the Bugesera Airport intended to support long-term growth; challenges include lack of economic diversification, high inflation, and wide current account deficit GDP (PPP): $46.543 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
